title: A participant that crashed while prepared
request:
a yes vote, a crash, and then a restart

./your_program.sh commit-recovery
init p1
begin tx1
prepare tx1 yes
crash
outcome tx1
recover
outcome tx1
note: The crash took everything the process believed and left the log untouched. `prepared` is the honest answer and the only safe one: the coordinator may have committed, and it may have aborted, and nothing on this machine can tell which.

title: A commit whose effect never landed
request:
a decision written to the log, and a crash before the store was touched

./your_program.sh commit-recovery
init p1
begin tx1
prepare tx1 yes
decide tx1 commit
crash
recover
outcome tx1
note: Logging the decision before applying it is what makes this recoverable at all. Recovery redoes the effect from the record; because redo is idempotent, doing it again after a second crash costs nothing.
